theme: An open day in St. Pete — the Croatia countdown is the real work.
greeting: Good morning, Dan. Just one call on the books today; the day's real work is clearing the last Croatia bookings before you fly next week, and giving Conor Kehoe's office a new time.

needsAttention.title: Give Conor Kehoe's office a new time
needsAttention.detail: You moved Friday's PRI stewardship call (the intro Eugenia Jackson set up), and Kate Tilley is holding the invite for your pick: Mon Sept 7, 9:00-12:30 ET, or Tue Sept 8, 9:00-11:30 ET. Monday sits cleaner — Tuesday is your Croatia departure.

needsAttention.title: Lock the last Dubrovnik night before you fly
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 19 Cavtat hotel night and the noon Komolac-to-Cavtat transfer are both still open and both p1. Charter connectivity is poor once aboard, so these have to be booked from dry land before the Sept 8 departure.

needsAttention.title: Confirm the checked bags are actually on the ticket
needsAttention.detail: The issued Basic Economy fare shows zero checked bags and you're carrying two 55L duffels. Verify the allowance on Eurowings Discover's own site and buy bags now if they aren't there — European counter fees run well above the online price.

flagged.title: A caregiver applied on Care.com
flagged.detail: Gabriella R. applied to your posted job; a couple of Care.com nudges are also sitting in the inbox.

flagged.title: First Stewardship Digest issue landed
flagged.detail: A new sustainability and stewardship newsletter launched this morning — timely reading ahead of the Conor Kehoe call.

inbox.noise: Otherwise it's Labor Day sales, LinkedIn and newsletter digests, and a Carrier HVAC alert misaddressed to an 'Andrew Ross.'
inbox.clear: Nothing else is waiting on a reply.

recipe.title: Roast Monkfish
recipe.why: Early autumn wants something firm and warming — monkfish holds up as the season turns.

tasks.title: Buy EU plug adapters + a US power strip

acts.line: The morning is open — the clear runway for the Croatia bookings that have to be locked from dry land before you fly.
One call at 3:30, Lauren Nadig at Brunswick, sitting alone in an otherwise quiet afternoon.
Settling into the new place on Central Ave with the girls for the week's stay.
